role: Curated mapping from thesis parts to evidence-ledger task prefixes. This is a non-canonical navigation aid consumed by scripts/derived/build.cjs to generate derived/evidence/<part>.md. A task prefix selects ledger records by ID (CL-<TASK>-*, A-<TASK>-*, C-<TASK>-*, S-<TASK>-*) plus the source records those records cite. It never adds, removes or reinterprets canonical records.
maintenance: Keep each part's tasks consistent with the work/<TASK>/report.md inputs in that chapter's front matter; the derived build fails when a front-matter report input names a task missing here. Curators may list additional tasks whose records are relevant beyond the front-matter reports.

c00.note: Front matter. The published article (paper/paper.html) is the only input; no ledger task evidence is drafted here.
